title: Provider placement: a statusless ACP tool_call_update carrying only a cwd loses that cwd on the description path
outcome: When an ACP provider sends a title-only pending frame, then a tool_call_update without a status that carries only the linked-worktree cwd, and the completing frame carries the command and RUN locator, the command is placed in that linked worktree and its native completion is associated.
acceptance: A title-only pending ACP frame, then a statusless tool_call_update with only a linked-worktree cwd, then a completing frame with the command text and RUN locator, keeps its provider, registration, artifact and native-completion association. Shown by a behavioural test that fails before the fix.
The review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
